   if self.m.actuator_trntype[i]==0:self.ctrl[i]=self.d.qpos[self.qids[i]]
  self.base=self.ctrl.copy();self.actions=[];self.logs=[]
  self.offset=np.array([0.,0.,0.065]);self.orient={h:self.d.body(h+'h_palm').xmat.reshape(3,3).copy() for h in ['l','r']}
 def pos(self,h,offset=None):
  b=self.d.body(h+'h_palm');return b.xpos+b.xmat.reshape(3,3)@(self.offset if offset is None else offset)
 def ik(self,h,target,rot=None,offset=None):

  qids=self.qids[ids];dids=self.dids[ids];bid=self.m.body(h+'h_palm').id
  self.k.qpos[:]=self.d.qpos;self.k.qvel[:]=0
  off=self.offset if offset is None else offset
  for _ in range(8):
   mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k);mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
   R=self.k.xmat[bid].reshape(3,3);p=self.k.xpos[bid]+R@off
   jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy();mujoco.mj_jac(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,p,bid)
   err=target-p;J=jp[:,dids]
   if rot is not None:
    er=Rotation.from_matrix(rot@R.T).as_rotvec();err=np.r_[err,er*.22];J=np.r_[J,jr[:,dids]*.22]
   dq=J.T@np.linalg.solve(J@J.T+np.eye(len(err))*.0005,err)
   self.k.qpos[qids]=np.clip(self.k.qpos[qids]+np.clip(dq,-.15,.15),self.m.jnt_range[self.jids[ids],0],self.m.jnt_range[self.jids[ids],1])
  self.ctrl[ids]=self.k.qpos[qids]

 def fingers(self,h,close):

  self.ctrl[st+2:st+20]=0
  self.ctrl[st+2]=.3;self.ctrl[st+3]=close*1.1;self.ctrl[st+6]=close*.9
  for i in [8,11,14,18]:self.ctrl[st+i]=close*1.2
  for i in [9,12,15,19]:self.ctrl[st+i]=close*2.5
 def step(self,targets={},rots={},balance=False):

   R=self.d.xmat[1].reshape(3,3);pitch=np.arctan2(R[0,2],R[2,2]);roll=np.arctan2(-R[1,2],R[2,2])
   self.ctrl[[4,9]]=self.base[[4,9]]+1.0*pitch+.25*self.d.qvel[4]
   self.ctrl[[1,6]]=self.base[[1,6]]-.5*roll-.1*self.d.qvel[3]
  a=np.clip(self.s.low.task.normalize_action(self.ctrl),-1,1);self.actions.append(a.copy());self.s.step(a)
